$comment: Curated game catalogue. `source` tells scripts/build-data.mjs which PokeAPI dexes/encounter versions feed each entry; `curated` points to keys in curated-availability.json; `closedDex` means the dex already lists every species in the game (no evolution expansion). HOME rules checked against home.pokemon.com/en-us/move and Serebii (Oct 2026).

home.how: Open Pokémon HOME on Switch, pick Scarlet/Violet and move it into a HOME box. It is registered on deposit and can be moved back later.
Same as Scarlet/Violet: deposit it in HOME from the game; it can come back later.
Same as Scarlet/Violet: deposit it in HOME from the game; it can come back later.
Deposit it in HOME from Legends: Z-A (HOME 4.0.0+). It can go back to Z-A later.
home.note: Z-A is its own compatibility group: a Pokémon caught in Z-A, or ever moved into Z-A, can never go to Scarlet/Violet or older games. It still counts for your HOME Pokédex.

home.how: Same as Legends: Z-A: deposit it in HOME from the game.
home.note: Z-A compatibility lock applies: it can never move to Scarlet/Violet or older games.

home.how: Deposit it in HOME from Legends: Arceus. It can come back later and arrives in a Strange Ball in BDSP, SV and Z-A.
Deposit it in HOME from BDSP. It can come back later.
Deposit it in HOME from Sword/Shield. It can come back later.

home.how: Same as Sword/Shield: deposit it in HOME from the game.
Same as Sword/Shield: deposit it in HOME from the game.
Move it to HOME from Let's Go. It is registered on deposit.
home.note: It can only ever return to Let's Go, and only if it was never moved into another game. Treat it as one-way.

home.how: Send it to HOME from FRLG (HOME 4.1.0+, one whole box at a time). Nothing can be sent back into FRLG.
home.note: Each transfer also syncs your FRLG Pokédex to HOME, so species you registered in FRLG count toward HOME's FRLG Kanto dex (Celebi reward) without moving each one. It is not confirmed that this also fills HOME's National Pokédex; deposit one to be sure.

home.how: In GO, open Settings → Pokémon HOME and send it with GO Transporter. It is registered when it arrives in HOME.
home.note: One-way. Legendary and Mythical Pokémon from GO can only be moved from HOME into a game whose Pokédex already has them registered. GO availability rotates with events.

home.how: Claimed in HOME mobile → Mystery Gift. It arrives straight in your HOME boxes and is registered.
Deposit in Pokémon Bank, then move Bank → HOME (needs HOME Premium). One-way.
home.note: Bank can't be newly downloaded and shuts down on 25 Feb 2027.
